SAPA Human Wellbeing Terrain Explorer

Human-only, aggregate terrain. Empirical mode averages observed respondents in the selected X/Y region. Conditional mode shows a five-dimensional Ridge estimate with the hidden traits fixed by sliders. The surface is descriptive and cross-sectional; it is not causal, clinical, or a population-optimal map.
Support masking: empirical cells require N ≥ 10. Conditional sliders use standardized Big Five units; support is a five-dimensional diagnostic, not a probability. Source: SAPA V5 (23,679 respondents; aggregate terrain cohort shown in bundle).
